title: No man’s sky meets windwaker
author: thegonelf
selftext: An endless sea of islands to explore is my idea for a cozy game. Test it out on itchio https://gonelf.itch.io/drift-atlas

comments.author: TheMightyOscar
comments.body: Charming and it plays smoothly on the browser! I love that it saves your save after closing down the tab

replies.author: thegonelf
replies.body: Yup, I also vibecoded the server for that

comments.author: michaelmb62
comments.body: Really good stuff man. Just played a little bit but looks real nice. Couldnt figure out how to fish though. What do i gotta tap?

replies.author: thegonelf
replies.body: You need to stop the raft so then you can see the fishing action, but that’s great feedback.

replies.author: thegonelf
replies.body: Game updated now it stops the raft for you

replies.author: michaelmb62
replies.body: Didn't see any options for fishing is what I meant, sorry. Should've been more specific.

replies.author: michaelmb62
replies.body: Sweet, I thought i was supposed to left click to fish.
